name: Luxury Typography
what_it_means: Luxury typographic design lets elegant letterforms carry the brand. Think oversized high-contrast serifs, refined italics, wide letter spaced capitals and a near-monochrome palette with a touch of gold. Restraint, slow pacing and impeccable spacing signal exclusivity.
signature_moves: Black / ivory palette with metallic accent
Lots of negative space, centered symmetry
best_for: Fashion, jewellery, hotels, perfume, fine dining
prompt_template: B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ] ** Design a homepage for [LUXURY BRAND] using Luxury Typography as the main visual. Deep black background (#0E0D0B), ivory text (#F3EDE2) and a muted gold accent (#C6A15B) for thin 1px rules and small details. Hero: the brand name in an oversized high-contrast serif (Cormorant Garamond / Didot, 160px+), with one word in italic. Navigation and labels in tiny uppercase with 0.4em letter-spacing. Centered, symmetric composition with huge margins. A single thin-outline CTA button. Very slow fade-in animations. No icons, no bright colours, no rounded shapes.
